# Vendored RNBO Move drivers

`input-driver.rnbopat` and `led-driver.rnbopat` are unmodified copies from
[Cycling74/rnbo.move.templates](https://github.com/Cycling74/rnbo.move.templates)
(commit de9093c0f33fc14c38501f47a113fe442c940239), MIT licensed, see `LICENSE.md`.

`rnbo/tools/patch.py` embeds them as subpatchers of `rnbo/patchers/lxr-move.maxpat`.
